business_summary: SS Retail Limited sales consumer electronics products in India. It offers mobile phones, pre-owned mobile phones; bluetooth speakers, sound bars, and trolley/karaoke speakers; air buds/ear buds, neck bands, and headphones; smart watches; power banks and wireless power banks, power adaptors, chargers, type C cables, lightning cables, micro cables and multi-pin cables and memory cards, pen drives, and on the go pen drives; and televisions, laptops, and tablets, as well as wholesales mobile phones. The company also provides ancillary services, which includes mobile protection plans, anti-theft software, credit / EMI (equated monthly instalment) facilities, and recharge of mobile phones. It operates through stores. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Kolhapur, India.
